activity.install.title: Enable work animation
activity.install.body: Add the 12 read-only status hooks below to %@. They send only hashed work status to this Mac, preserve other hooks and create a backup. They do not read chat history or output or control session content. Most run in the background; Codex runs session-end events synchronously with a 2-second timeout. Review and trust them in Codex after installation.
activity.trust.title: Review and trust in Codex
activity.trust.body:
1. Run this in Terminal:
%@

2. In Codex CLI, enter /hooks, then review and trust all 12 Pulse definitions.

3. Return here and choose “Check connection”. Work animation stays off until trust is confirmed.
